name: Researcher's Notes
landing_text: I am about to step into a new frontier. I leave behind my notes - though I suspect this plague to consume them - hoping they can escape if I cannot. It might be difficult to decipher them at first, but you'll succeed as you explore more of the Risus. Nonetheless, if possible, I will ask you to not follow in my footsteps.                     -R. Tenebrora
subtitle: Guide to Assimilation
